title: Spring Data, JPA & Hibernate
intro: Hibernate and JPA interview questions are a staple of every Java backend interview — the entity lifecycle, persistence context and the first-level cache, lazy vs eager fetching, the dreaded N+1 query problem and its solutions (entity graphs, JOIN FETCH, projections), @Transactional propagation, optimistic vs pessimistic locking, second-level cache, batching, and the differences between JPA, Hibernate, MyBatis and JOOQ. This page covers every Hibernate/JPA question that recurs in interviews, with code snippets and the SQL Hibernate actually emits. Expect senior interviews to dig into transaction internals and connection-pool sizing — both covered here in depth.
